title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30235v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourage

translated_title: PixelOne：单次前向传播实现从选项到像素的GUI定位
translated_abstract: GUI定位要求在低延迟下实现精准点击。近期的模型（如GUI-Decisions和GUI-Swift）使用固定的全局分箱加局部细化的方式，在一次前向传播中预测坐标。然而，截图下采样会丢失定位小型控件所需的细节，而在更高分辨率下，固定分箱会覆盖更大的像素范围。我们提出PixelOne，它将空间知识从搜索教师模型迁移到学生模型，使学生模型能够直接以原生分辨率从截图中预测点击。教师模型利用VideoJEV的文本选项评分器来选择行和列，并逐步放大候选区域。学生模型继承教师的参数，并通过空间蒸馏结合边界框监督来匹配教师在已探索区域上的分布。在推理阶段，同一个决策头选择一个视觉token，随后一个轻量级的像素头在该token内部预测点击位置，全部在一次前向传播中完成。点击对齐损失鼓励……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PixelOne通过将搜索教师模型的渐进式空间知识蒸馏给学生模型，使学生能在原生分辨率下于单次前向传播中直接从截图像素预测出精准的点击坐标。
en_tdlr: PixelOne distills spatial knowledge from a progressive search teacher into a student model that predicts precise click coordinates directly from native-resolution screenshot pixels in a single forward pass.
